# Shipwright

> Claude Code plugins that take a project from the idea to the launch (showcase site, web app, SaaS, desktop or mobile app): the order of work in stages with a gate each, the rules of each trade, and the means to prove each step (key tasks played on phone and desktop, access control tried with two accounts, rendering measured in a real browser, a reference bank of sites recognised as excellent). It also audits across 37 domains (247 criteria, evidence required) with two scores out of 10. Free, MIT, no telemetry, English and French.

Shipwright (called quality-pack until version 0.7; its commands were `/qp:…`) is a Claude Code plugin marketplace named `shipwright`, hosted at https://github.com/1AngelMicka/quality-pack. It is installed from inside Claude Code with `/plugin` commands, never with npm. An agent that cannot type them clones the repository and runs `node plugins/core/scripts/sw.mjs skills`, then `sw.mjs skill <name>` to read a skill with its paths filled in, or `sw.mjs enable` to write the project's `.claude/settings.json`; from a terminal outside a session, `claude plugin marketplace add 1AngelMicka/quality-pack` then `claude plugin install sw@shipwright`. It requires Claude Code, Node.js 18+ and git. Commands after install: `/sw:kickoff`, `/sw:audit`, `/sw:fix`, `/sw:handoff`. Skills that load on their own: `from-zero` (stages from an idea to a launched SaaS), `saas-foundations` (isolation between customers, accounts, subscriptions), `security-testing` (access control played with two accounts, login probe, passive scan, supply chain, threat model; local or staging only), `mobile-app` (iOS and Android, store blockers), `premium-craft` (finish and identity, measured), `user-testing`, and the design skills.

## Install and use

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/1AngelMicka/quality-pack/blob/main/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): step-by-step instructions for an AI agent helping a user install, configure and use the pack, with checks and common errors. Start here.
- [README (English)](https://github.com/1AngelMicka/quality-pack/blob/main/README.en.md): overview, install, commands, scoring, token economy, troubleshooting.
- [README (français)](https://github.com/1AngelMicka/quality-pack/blob/main/README.md): même contenu en français.
- [Documentation site](https://1angelmicka.github.io/quality-pack/en/): the same content as a web page.
